items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, Fats was active. I think at that time, he was playing the organ at the Lincoln Theatre, I think

ctx.x: And then after I finally had gotten a little better control of the keys, he would just play in any key -- you never knew what he was gonna do; he caught himself sometimes trying to trick you, you know, just for fun --and it was a very valuable musical experience for me, playing with him.
Did you -- was Fats active -- Fat Warner, active around that time? He must have been, I suppose.
Yes, Fats was active. I think at that time, he was playing the organ at the Lincoln Theatre, I think
